message: Last summer, we had this unexpected blackout, and my friend started pacing like a restless puppy. While I was rummaging for my trusty flashlight and power bank, she was convinced we’d be living like cavemen. I reassured her with a lantern and some snacks, and soon we were huddled up, sharing stories in the glow of a cozy light. It turns out, a little preparation goes a long way in keeping the calm when the lights go out. Do you have a go-to comfort during a power outage?
